title: Pool Service Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Pool Service: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Pool Service Estimate Worksheet covers pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature. The residential pool-service coordinator records Residential Pool Service observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Pool Service Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Pool Service exceptions visible until the residential pool-service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pool Service Estimate Worksheet at residential pool, spa, equipment pad, chemical storage, and access gate. Document pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature identity before Residential Pool Service begins. Compare pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature findings with stated Residential Pool Service criteria; route unresolved Residential Pool Service issues to qualified pool-service reviewer. For Pool Service Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Residential Pool Service. Ask qualified pool-service reviewer to review Residential Pool Service conditions beyond the residential pool-service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Property estimate review and customer identity
sections.guidance: Identify the customer, asset or property, estimator, and basis date before pricing the work.

sections.title: Pricing options and customer decision inputs
sections.guidance: Price the observable work and options. Keep concealed conditions and unconfirmed quantities out of fixed scope.

blocks.label: Residential Pool Service scope observations
items: Filter pressure, flow, pump, and leak condition

sections.title: Estimate exception and change conditions

blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Pool Service and notify residential pool-service coordinator when water, chemical, circulation, barrier, visibility, or safe-use control remains unresolved.
